evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official North East Investment Zone tax-site page identifies the International Advanced Manufacturing Strategic Site (IAMSS) as one of two designated tax sites, states that the designation took effect on 8 April 2024, and describes the IAMSS site as land about two miles west of Sunderland around the Nissan Motor factory immediately west of the A19. The Designation of Special Tax Sites Regulations 2024 designate the areas edged and hatched in red on the map entitled 'International Advanced Manufacturing Strategic Site (IAMSS) Tax Site', dated 26 January 2024, and state that the designation takes effect on 8 April 2024. The official map attachment supplies the exact legal site boundary.
